queries.sql: SELECT courses.*, subjects.code AS subject_code, subjects.name AS subject_name, users.name AS teacher_name, classes.name AS class_name, classes.grade AS class_grade, academic_years.name AS academic_year_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_students WHERE course_students.course_id = courses.id) AS student_count FROM `courses` JOIN `subjects` ON `subjects`.`id` = `courses`.`subject_id` JOIN `teachers` ON `teachers`.`id` = `courses`.`teacher_id` JOIN `users` ON `users`.`id` = `teachers`.`user_id` JOIN `classes` ON `classes`.`id` = `courses`.`class_id` JOIN `academic_years` ON `academic_years`.`id` = `courses`.`academic_year_id` WHERE `courses`.`id` = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT q.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions qs WHERE qs.quiz_id = q.id) AS question_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qs2.points), 0) FROM questions qs2 WHERE qs2.quiz_id = q.id) AS total_points, `qa`.`id` AS `attempt_id`, `qa`.`status` AS `attempt_status`, `qa`.`score` AS `attempt_score`, `qa`.`started_at` AS `attempt_started_at`, `qa`.`submitted_at` AS `attempt_submitted_at` FROM `quizzes` `q` LEFT JOIN `quiz_attempts` `qa` ON `qa`.`quiz_id` = `q`.`id` AND `qa`.`student_id` = 1 WHERE `q`.`course_id` = 1 AND `q`.`is_published` = 1 ORDER BY q.end_at IS NULL ASC, `q`.`end_at` ASC, `q`.`id` DESC
